programs.title: Melodies Of The Heart
programs.desc: A determined mother refuses to bow to the rigid expectations and barriers imposed by society, choosing instead to carve out a path where her daughter's dreams can take flight. Parth Samthaan, Rishita Kothari.

programs.title: We Are Family
programs.desc: A heart-breaking story of divorced woman who was diagnosed with a fatal cancer. Now she is doing her best to find a step mom for her amazing three children. Kareena Kapoor, Kajol , Siddharth Malhotra, Niranjan Iyengar, Kajol.

programs.title: Nazar Andaaz
programs.desc: Sudhir, who is visually impaired, shares his home only with his maid Bhavani until he temporarily brings in Ali to assist during her absence, unknowingly setting off a tense rivalry as jealousy builds between Bhavani and Ali. Vikrant Deshmukh.

programs.desc: Determined to fulfill her mother's dream of a better life, a young woman faces numerous trials and personal loss, only to have her journey further complicated by a man she meets along the way. Hiba Nawab, Krushal Ahuja.
